systems: Nix, Bazel, Terraform: flake.lock, MODULE.bazel.lock and .terraform.lock.hcl all distinguish a requirement from a lock, which is exactly why this row names a cookbook commit whose LOCK pins 1.31.0 rather than one whose manifest merely admits it [X]

SLSA, in-toto, Sigstore: a release record is a statement about what was built and from what, and the field has moved to machine-checkable ones; this ledger row is prose that gate T checks mechanically, weaker in kind and stated as such [X]

Kubernetes, Chef, Terraform: all three key their release tooling off the PR object rather than the branch, which is what release-goal.sh does when it reads the window from GitHub instead of from the commit messages [X]
